verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only ceiling specs: up to 4K, up to 240 FPS (60 FPS at 4K), and 4:4:4 color. It does not show that quality adapts when the connection degrades, or that users can choose resolution and frame rate themselves. One community report of smooth play over 4G is anecdotal and does not describe an adaptive-quality mechanism, so neither part of the story is evidenced.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
